title: Current
description: The research:current block in research/CURRENT.md — research-level working memory. It answers 'where has the research got to', as against ACTIVE.json's 'what is happening right now', so it changes on the scale of a research question rather than an experiment. Three maturities are tracked separately and must never be collapsed into one number: a system can be fully built while a new mechanism inside it is still E1, and the environment may be unable to verify a whole class of question regardless of either.

objective.description: The research question this whole line of work is trying to answer. Null before one has been chosen, which is a legitimate state and not an error.

working_pieces.description: What has actually been built, as against what is believed about it.

architecture_frozen.description: False unless ARCHITECT.md says otherwise. A provisional shape that has never been challenged is a suspicion, not a design.

highest_value_uncertainties.description: Ordered by what would change the most if it turned out differently.

active_research.description: The hypotheses currently being worked, with what each one claims. The IDs alone are a registry, not a definition; a session that can read only IDs cannot choose the next experiment.

current_frontier.description: Where the work has actually reached.
